Full Compliance Infrastructure
Loan-level compliance checks

Trust that all loans adhere to regulatory and the highest industry standards throughout the origination lifecycle. Pylon’s loan-level compliance checks and reports ensure a full audit trail and your peace-of-mind.

Automated disclosures

Pylon auto-generates disclosures to borrowers at every stage of the origination process, from application to delivery to ensure total compliance.

State-level licensing

Pylon is a licensed mortgage lender in 38 states. We’re rapidly expanding to full nationwide coverage with new licenses added frequently.

Full Compliance Infrastructure

We’ve designed an industry best in class compliance infrastructure to govern our platform and our hiring practices, training, internal audits, policies and procedures.
